commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; C="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/growbox-ml-controller/control"; echo CONTROL=$C; echo REMOTE=$(git -C "$C" remote get-url origin); echo '--- ssh config ---'; (ssh -G github.com 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(hostname|port|controlmaster|controlpersist|controlpath) ' || true); echo '--- benchmark default ---'; python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,time,statistics,os
from pathlib import Path
c=Path.home()/"agent-workspace/repos/growbox-ml-controller/control"
cmds={
 'ls_remote':['git','ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/agent-control'],
 'fetch_depth1':['git','fetch','--quiet','--no-tags','--depth','1','origin','agent-control'],
 'pull_depth256':['git','pull','--rebase','--depth','256','--no-tags','origin','agent-control'],
}
for name,cmd in cmds.items():
    vals=[]
    for i in range(3):
        t=time.monotonic(); p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=c,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT); dt=time.monotonic()-t
        vals.append(dt); print(f'{name}[{i+1}] exit={p.returncode} sec={dt:.3f} out={p.stdout.strip()[:120]}')
    print(f'{name} median={statistics.median(vals):.3f} min={min(vals):.3f} max={max(vals):.3f}')
PY
 echo '--- benchmark ssh multiplex ---'; SOCKDIR="$HOME/Library/Application Support/local-agent/ssh-control"; mkdir -p "$SOCKDIR"; export GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -o ControlMaster=auto -o ControlPersist=120 -o ControlPath=$SOCKDIR/%C"; python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,time,statistics,os
from pathlib import Path
c=Path.home()/"agent-workspace/repos/growbox-ml-controller/control"
env=os.environ.copy()
cmds={
 'mux_ls_remote':['git','ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/agent-control'],
 'mux_fetch_depth1':['git','fetch','--quiet','--no-tags','--depth','1','origin','agent-control'],
}
for name,cmd in cmds.items():
    vals=[]
    for i in range(4):
        t=time.monotonic(); p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=c,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env); dt=time.monotonic()-t
        vals.append(dt); print(f'{name}[{i+1}] exit={p.returncode} sec={dt:.3f} out={p.stdout.strip()[:120]}')
    print(f'{name} median={statistics.median(vals):.3f} min={min(vals):.3f} max={max(vals):.3f}')
PY
 echo BENCHMARK_OK
